# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a tiny, lovely woman who retains an almost youthful face featuring rosy cheeks, sweet lips, dimples, and large, gentle wood-brown eyes with flecks of gold. Her thick, wavy, snow-white hair is styled in flattering puffs and coils. She favors delicate, youthful attire such as cream muslin with light-colored roses or organdy dresses adorned with frills and laces.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

## Personality

Rosalind is an imaginative, romantic, and playful woman who enjoys pretense, hospitality, and delicate beauty, often feeling like a young girl at heart despite her years. Though possessing a practical and cheerful disposition, she has a brooding, moody side coupled with deep pride that once led to a long-standing estrangement. She despises aging and conventionality, preferring her own imaginative lifestyle in secluded quiet over formal social obligations.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)_

- Proud  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

- Entertaining with echoes  <sub>[v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)</sub>
- Baking and culinary skills  <sub>[v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>

## Goals

- To maintain a youthful, imaginative spirit despite her physical age  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- To preserve her secluded, peaceful life at Echo Cottage  <sub>[v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)</sub>

## History

Rosalind Penrose lived a secluded, dreamlike existence at Echo Cottage in Welby, cared for by a young hired girl whom she habitually called 'Belinda'. Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke stumbled upon her stone cottage and immediately formed a close friendship with her, discovering that she shared their love for romance and imaginative pretense. Nell later introduced Cedric Stanhope to Rosalind, unaware at first of his connection to Rosalind's past, which brought Rosalind into contact with the son of her former fiancé, Stephen Stanhope. After Cedric mentioned meeting her in a letter to his father, Stephen returned to seek her out. The long-separated couple reconciled, and on the final Wednesday of August, they were married beneath her garden's honeysuckle trellis. Following the ceremony, they departed for a trip to the Pacific coast, planning to reside in Boston while returning every summer to Echo Cottage.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Named Rosalind by her father because he adored the fragrance of lavender sheets in East Welby where he met her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Engaged to Stephen Stanhope twenty-five years ago before a quarrel separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- Inherited Echo Cottage, an ancient stone house built by her grandfather eighty years prior  <sub>[v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>
- Began taking in young girls from the Bowman family a decade ago after her mother died  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Pretending to be a girl myself comes so naturally when I am in their company. I really despise accept that I am advanced in years.  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

> A few women are old maids from birth, others attain the status of an old maid, and still others find old maidenhood forced on them.  <sub>[v2 c23 P13](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0013)</sub>

> I was certain I would prefer being an unmarried woman for ten centuries over marrying anyone who was not Stephen Stanhope.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> I am actually a quite cheerful, satisfied small person despite my fractured heart.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
